description: Configure CUSTOM tracking speed (Center's `customized` track speed): enable it, set the per-axis Pan/Tilt speeds 1-10, and toggle the per-axis Auto buttons. Bare call reads current state from the status push (tracking_settings, locks included read-only). Writes ride UDP 9999 keys 04/07/0a/06/09 (pan/tilt travel as float32 slider/10 on the wire; keys 06/09 are the Auto buttons — hardware-verified against horizontal_auto/vertical_auto). The AXIS LOCKS have no known write path (not UDP, REST guesses 404) — shown read-only. Verified by tracking_settings readback.
name: obsbot_tail2_track_custom
